what: the model-scope consequence of of3t-adaln's softmax finding, computed from the 547-tensor per-tensor array by splitting the diffusion arm into the half downstream of a no-config attention softmax and the half that is not. Nothing new was run.

everything_else_in_the_arm.note: no softmax lever touches any of it. 13 of 259 tensors are inside the 2.0e-02 bar, holding 1.1541 % of the model.

headline: The softmax is confirmed as the dominant defect -- it owns 27.2441 % of the model at mass-weighted rel 10.3684. But NO softmax lever brings the diffusion arm inside the bar, because the other 23.8917 % sits at 0.1855 and is untouched by any of them. Even an EXACT softmax leaves the arm at 0.1867, which is 9.3x the 2.0e-02 mass-weighted bar.

extrapolation.caveat: the factors are of3t-adaln's BLOCK-ARM measurements with a generic cotangent, applied here to model-scope rels. That is an extrapolation and is labelled as one everywhere it appears; the row's own DOESNOT says how 55x at one block composes over 24 blocks and 48 samples is not established.

what_the_other_half_is.total: 23.8917 % of the model at mass-weighted rel 0.1855, 9.3x the bar
what_the_other_half_is.the_awkward_part: the largest member is the SISTER AdaLN gain -- the tensor I used as the exoneration control at pass 153 and described as 'clean' against the failing leaf's 10.6980. It is 59x better and it is still 9x over bar. A differential control being valid does not make its reference arm passing, and I should have said 'less bad', not 'clean'.
what_the_other_half_is.owner: none. This is now the campaign's largest unowned item.

levers.forward: 2.274755e-02 -> 6.888150e-04, a 33x improvement on a value that is ON THE INFERENCE PATH
levers.cost: UNKNOWN -- nobody has measured it. This is the single missing number in the decision.
4.22x the fused kernel at [1,16,1024,1024], per its own docstring

the_decision_the_row_handed_the_orchestr.recommendation: SPLIT THE TWO CASES, because they have different strengths and only one of them is strong. (a) As a TRAINING-PARITY lever the case is weak and should not be taken to the release gate on its own: no softmax lever reaches the bar, and even the float64 bound leaves the arm 9.3x outside it. (b) As an INFERENCE-ACCURACY finding it is unmeasured and possibly strong -- the shipped softmax carries 2.274755e-02 relative error on the inference path at [1,16,384,384] and a kernel config improves that 33x. That deserves a fold-level measurement in Angstrom against the seed floor, not a rel number, and it is cheap.
the_decision_the_row_handed_the_orchestr.a_correction_the_row_found_that_outlives: `_accurate_softmax`'s docstring says a compute kernel config changes nothing. On [1,16,384,384] on a p300c it changes 2.274755e-02 into 6.888150e-04. That is a wrong statement in shipped source that has presumably been steering people away from the cheap lever.
